name: Beijing Tongrentang Co., Ltd
summary: Beijing Tongrentang Co., Ltd engages in the production and sale of traditional Chinese medicine preparations in China and internationally. The company offers various product dosage forms, such as pills, powders, medicated wines, capsules, oral liquids, and drop pills. Its products are used for cardiovascular, cerebrovascular, gynecology, heat-clearing, respiratory system, nourishing and calming, digestive, pediatrics, wind-dispelling and dampness removing, orthopedics, facial features, dermatological surgery, mental health, and food and beverages applications.
